title: Protesters demonstrate and burn flag outside Hillel at University of Oregon

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated to mark the third anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel and to protest against the campus Jewish organization.
tea.want: Protesters demanded that the Hillel organization be removed from the University of Oregon campus.
tea.changed: Oct 9: The Oregon Hillel executive director stated they are working with law enforcement and the university to keep the community safe.

summary: On October 7, 2026, a group of demonstrators gathered outside the Hillel house at the University of Oregon in Eugene on the third anniversary of the Hamas attacks. Masked participants burned an American flag on the sidewalk, chanted in praise of the October 7 attackers, and demanded the removal of the Jewish student organization from campus. According to reports, the demonstration involved roughly 25 protesters. The Oregon Hillel Foundation's executive director condemned the action as harassment, intimidation, and antisemitic, while expressing expectations for the university to hold involved individuals accountable. No official administrative or police response was detailed in the sources beyond statements from school leadership support noted by the Hillel director.
response: No official response from university administration or police was detailed in the sources, though the Hillel executive director noted public support from school leaders and lawmakers.

updates.text: Protesters gathered outside the University of Oregon Hillel house, burned an American flag, and chanted slogans.
Oregon Hillel executive director released a statement condemning the demonstration as harassment and calling for accountability.
